title: Fort Témiscamingue Chief Factor’s House

terrainReference.basis: Public original source elevation on the shore-facing grounds next to the ruins.

mapIdentity.provider: OSM house ruin polygon and corroborating written site inventory
mapIdentity.scope: The government management plan places the factor’s house near the west shore in the southwestern group. The south-of-forge OSM house ruins match that relationship and show a central house outline plus a narrower north projection. The unnamed feature is an approximate cross-identification.

note: Roy identifies the 1888 house, rear wing and central covered passage. The surviving chimney is independently documented.
